title: SEBI Settlement Regulations, 2026 Effective from November 7, 2026!
content:
# SEBI Settlement Regulations, 2026 Effective from November 7, 2026!

Ek important update hai! Government ne SEBI (Settlement of Administrative and Civil Proceedings) Regulations, 2026 announce kiya hai, jo aaj se, yaani November 7, 2026 se, force mein aa gaye hain.

Yeh naye regulations Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) ke administrative aur civil proceedings ke settlement ke framework ko streamline karte hain.

*   **Effective Date:** The SEBI (Settlement of Administrative and Civil Proceedings) Regulations, 2026, have come into force from November 7, 2026.
*   **Replaces Old Regulations:** These new regulations were notified on October 8, 2026, and replace the earlier SEBI (Settlement Proceedings) Regulations, 2018.
*   **New Facilities:** SEBI ne online settlement application facility, ek settlement amount calculator, Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs), aur ek dedicated help desk bhi provide kiya hai.
*   **Application Fees:** Applications ke liye non-refundable fee prescribed hai: ₹25,000 for natural persons (individuals) and ₹35,000 for other applicants.
*   **Minimum Settlement Amount:** Minimum settlement amount ₹3 lakh hai for first-time applicants and ₹7 lakh for other applicants.
*   **Key Document:** Yeh update SEBI Press Release No. 70/2026 dated November 6, 2026, ke through confirm kiya gaya hai.
